kebab_example: aliyun slb create-load-balancer-http-listener --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --load-balancer-id lb-bp1c9vixxjh92q83tw00000 --listener-port 80 --health-check on --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateLoadBalancerHTTPListener

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance.

You can obtain the region ID from the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html list or by invoking the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27584.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
传统型负载均衡实例的地域ID。

您可以从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html列表或通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27584.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 传统型负载均衡实例ID
parameters.name: load_balancer_id

parameters.help_en:
The peak bandwidth of the listener. Unit: Mbit/s. Valid values:

<props="intl">-1: The peak bandwidth is not limited.</props>

<props="china">

-1: The peak bandwidth is not limited.

1 to 5120: The peak bandwidth of the listener. The sum of the peak bandwidth values of all listeners cannot exceed the peak bandwidth of the instance.

</props>
parameters.help_zh:
监听的带宽峰值，单位：Mbps。取值：

<props="intl">-1：不限制带宽峰值。</props>

<props="china">

-1：不限制带宽峰值。

1~5120：监听的带宽峰值，所有监听的带宽峰值之和不能超过实例的带宽峰值。

</props>
parameters.name: bandwidth

parameters.help_en:
The frontend port used by the instance.

Valid values: 1 to 65535
parameters.help_zh:
实例前端使用的端口。

取值：1~65535
parameters.name: listener_port

parameters.help_en:
The backend port used by the instance.

Valid values: 1 to 65535.

This parameter is required if you do not use a virtual server group (the VServerGroupId parameter is not specified)
parameters.help_zh:
实例后端使用的端口。

取值：1~65535。

如果不使用虚拟服务器组（不指定VServerGroupId参数），则该参数必选
parameters.name: backend_server_port

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the `X-Forwarded-For` header to retrieve the IP address of the client. Valid values:
on (default): yes.
off: no
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启通过`X-Forwarded-For`头字段获取来访客户端IP。取值：
on（默认值）：是。
off：否
parameters.name: xforwarded_for

parameters.help_en:
The scheduling algorithm. Valid values:

wrr (default): Backend servers with higher weights receive more requests than backend servers with lower weights.

rr: Requests are distributed to backend servers in sequence
parameters.help_zh:
调度算法。取值：

wrr（默认值）：权重值越高的后端服务器，被轮询到的概率也越高。

rr：按照访问顺序依次将外部请求依序分发到后端服务器
parameters.name: scheduler

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable session persistence. Valid values:

on: yes.

off (default): no
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启会话保持。取值：

on：是。

off（默认值）：否
parameters.name: sticky_session

parameters.help_en:
The method used to handle cookies. Valid values:

insert: insert cookie.

    When a client accesses Server Load Balancer for the first time, Server Load Balancer inserts a cookie into the response. The next time the client sends a request with this cookie, Server Load Balancer forwards the request to the backend server that was previously recorded.

server: rewrite cookie.

  When Server Load Balancer discovers a user-defined cookie, it rewrites the original cookie. The next time the client sends a request with the new cookie, Server Load Balancer forwards the request to the backend server that was previously recorded.

This parameter is required when StickySession is set to on
parameters.help_zh:
Cookie处理方式。取值：

insert：植入Cookie。

    客户端第一次访问时，负载均衡会在返回请求中植入Cookie，下次客户端携带此Cookie访问，负载均衡服务会将请求定向转发给之前记录到的后端服务器上。

server：重写Cookie。

  负载均衡发现用户自定义了Cookie，将会对原来的Cookie进行重写，下次客户端携带新的Cookie访问，负载均衡服务会将请求定向转发给之前记录到的后端服务器。

当StickySession值为on时，必须指定该参数
parameters.name: sticky_session_type

fields.help_en: The tag key of the listener. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. The tag key cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 监听的标签键。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value of the listener. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `acs:`. The tag value cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 监听的标签值。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en:
The timeout period of a cookie. Unit: seconds.

Valid values: 1 to 86400.

This parameter is required when StickySession is set to on and StickySessionType is set to insert
parameters.help_zh:
Cookie超时时间。单位：秒。

取值：1~86400。

当StickySession为on且StickySessionType为insert时，该参数必选
parameters.name: cookie_timeout

parameters.help_en:
The cookie configured on the server.

The cookie must be 1 to 200 characters in length and can contain only ASCII letters and digits. It cannot contain commas (,), semicolons (;), or spaces. It cannot start with a dollar sign ($).

This parameter is required when StickySession is set to on and StickySessionType is set to server
parameters.help_zh:
服务器上配置的Cookie。

长度为1~200个字符，只能包含ASCII英文字母和数字字符，不能包含半角逗号（,）、半角分号（;）或空格，也不能以美元符号（$）开头。

当StickySession为on且StickySessionType为server时，该参数必选
parameters.name: cookie

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable health checks. Valid values:

on: enables health checks.

off: disables health checks
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启健康检查。取值：

on：开启健康检查。

off：不开启健康检查
parameters.name: health_check

parameters.help_en:
The health check method used by the HTTP listener. Valid values: head and get.

This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on
parameters.help_zh:
监听HTTP类型健康检查的健康检查方法。取值：head或get。

HealthCheck值为on时才会有效
parameters.name: health_check_method

parameters.help_en:
The domain name used for health checks. Valid values:

$_ip: the private network IP address of the backend server. If $_ip is specified or this parameter is not specified, Server Load Balancer uses the private network IP address of each backend server as the domain name for health checks.

domain: The domain name must be 1 to 80 characters in length and can contain only letters, digits, periods (.), and hyphens (-).

This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on
parameters.help_zh:
用于健康检查的域名，取值：

$_ip： 后端服务器的私网IP。当指定了IP或该参数未指定时，负载均衡会使用各后端服务器的私网IP当做健康检查使用的域名。

domain：域名长度为1~80字符，只能包含字母、数字、半角句号（.）和短划线（-）。

在HealthCheck值为on时才会有效
parameters.name: health_check_domain

parameters.help_en:
The URI used for health checks.

The URI must be 1 to 80 characters in length and can contain only letters, digits, hyphens (-), forward slashes (/), periods (.), percent signs (%), question marks (?), number signs (#), and ampersands (&). The URI cannot be only a forward slash (/), but it must start with a forward slash (/).

This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on
parameters.help_zh:
用于健康检查的URI。

长度限制为1~80个字符，只能使用字母、数字和短划线（-）、正斜线（/）、半角句号（.）、百分号（%）、半角问号（?）、井号（#）和and（&）这些字符。URI不能只为正斜线（/），但必须以正斜线（/）开头。

在HealthCheck值为on时才会有效
parameters.name: health_check_uri

parameters.help_en:
The number of consecutive successful health checks before the health status of a backend server changes from fail to success.

Valid values: 2 to 10.

This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查连续成功多少次后，将后端服务器的健康检查状态由失败判定为成功。

取值：2~10。

在HealthCheck值为on时才会有效
parameters.name: healthy_threshold

parameters.help_en:
The number of consecutive failed health checks before the health status of a backend server changes from success to fail.

Valid values: 2 to 10.

This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查连续失败多少次后，将后端服务器的健康检查状态由成功判定为失败。

取值：2~10。

在HealthCheck值为on时才会有效
parameters.name: unhealthy_threshold

parameters.help_en:
The amount of time to wait for a response from a health check. If the backend ECS instance does not respond within the specified time, the health check fails. Unit: seconds.

Valid values: 1 to 300.

This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on
parameters.help_zh:
接收来自运行状况检查的响应需要等待的时间。如果后端ECS在指定的时间内没有正确响应，则判定为健康检查失败。单位：秒。

取值：1~300。

在HealthCheck值为on时才会有效
parameters.name: health_check_timeout

parameters.help_en:
The port of the backend server used for health checks.

Valid values: 1 to 65535.

This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查的后端服务器的端口。

取值： 1~65535。

在HealthCheck值为on时才会有效
parameters.name: health_check_connect_port

parameters.help_en:
The interval between two consecutive health checks. Unit: seconds.

Valid values: 1 to 50.

This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查的时间间隔。单位：秒。

取值： 1~50。

在HealthCheck值为on时才会有效
parameters.name: health_check_interval

parameters.help_en:
The HTTP status code that indicates a successful health check. Separate multiple HTTP status codes with commas (,).

Valid values: http_2xx (default), http_3xx, http_4xx, and http_5xx.

This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查正常的HTTP状态码，多个状态码用逗号分隔。

取值：http_2xx（默认值）、http_3xx、http_4xx或http_5xx。

在HealthCheck值为on时才会有效
parameters.name: health_check_http_code

parameters.help_en: The ID of the virtual server group
parameters.help_zh: 虚拟服务器组ID
parameters.name: vserver_group_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the `SLB-IP` header to retrieve the virtual IP address (VIP) of the client request. Valid values:
on: yes.
off (default): no
parameters.help_zh:
是否通过`SLB-IP`头字段获取客户端请求的VIP（Virtual IP address）。取值：
on：是。
off（默认值）：否
parameters.name: xforwarded_for_slb_ip

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the `SLB-ID` header to retrieve the SLB instance ID. Valid values:
on: yes.
off (default): no
parameters.help_zh:
是否通过`SLB-ID`头字段获取负载均衡实例ID。取值：
on：是。
off（默认值）：否
parameters.name: xforwarded_for_slb_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the `X-Forwarded-Proto` header to retrieve the listener protocol of the Server Load Balancer instance. Valid values:
on: yes.
off (default): no
parameters.help_zh:
是否通过`X-Forwarded-Proto`头字段获取负载均衡实例的监听协议。取值：
on：是。
off（默认值）：否
parameters.name: xforwarded_for_proto

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable `Gzip` compression for specific file types. Valid values:
on (default): yes.
off: no
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启`Gzip`压缩，对特定文件类型进行压缩。取值：
on（默认值）：是。
off：否
parameters.name: gzip

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the access control list (ACL) bound to the listener.

This parameter is required when AclStatus is set to on
parameters.help_zh:
监听绑定的访问策略组ID。

当AclStatus参数的值为on时，该参数必选
parameters.name: acl_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of access control. Valid values:

white: Only requests from the IP addresses or CIDR blocks in the selected access control policy group are forwarded. Whitelists are applicable to scenarios in which you want to allow only specific IP addresses to access your service. Setting a whitelist poses risks. After a whitelist is set, only the IP addresses in the whitelist can access the Server Load Balancer listener.
 
  If a whitelist is enabled but no IP address is added to the access control policy group, the Server Load Balancer listener forwards all requests.

black: All requests from the IP addresses or CIDR blocks in the selected access control policy group are rejected. Blacklists are applicable to scenarios in which you want to block access from specific IP addresses.

  If a blacklist is enabled but no IP address is added to the access control policy group, the Server Load Balancer listener forwards all requests.

This parameter takes effect only when AclStatus is set to on
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制类型。取值：

white： 仅转发来自所选访问控制策略组中设置的IP地址或地址段的请求，白名单适用于只允许特定IP访问的场景。设置白名单存在一定业务风险。一旦设置白名单，就只有白名单中的IP可以访问负载均衡监听。
 
  如果开启了白名单访问，但访问策略组中没有添加任何IP，则负载均衡监听会转发全部请求。

black： 来自所选访问控制策略组中设置的IP地址或地址段的所有请求都不会转发，黑名单适用于只限制某些特定IP访问的场景。

  如果开启了黑名单访问，但访问策略组中没有添加任何IP，则负载均衡监听会转发全部请求。

当AclStatus参数的值为on时，该参数有效
parameters.name: acl_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable access control. Valid values:
on: yes.
off (default): no
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启访问控制功能。取值：
on：是。
off（默认值）：否
parameters.name: acl_status

parameters.help_en:
The custom listener name.

The name must be 1 to 256 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, hyphens (-), forward slashes (/), periods (.), and underscores (_)
parameters.help_zh:
自定义监听名称。

长度限制为1~256个字符，支持中文、字母、数字、短划线（-）、正斜线（/）、半角句号（.）和下划线（_）
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable HTTP-to-HTTPS redirection. Valid values:
on: yes.
off (default): no
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启HTTP至HTTPS的转发。取值：
on：是。
off（默认值）：否
parameters.name: listener_forward

parameters.help_en: The Redirection Port for HTTP-to-HTTPS listener forwarding
parameters.help_zh: HTTP至HTTPS的监听转发端口
parameters.name: forward_port

parameters.help_en:
The timeout period of an idle connection. Unit: seconds.

Default value: 15. Valid values: 1 to 60.

If no access request is received within the specified timeout period, Server Load Balancer temporarily breaks the current connection and re-establishes a new connection when the next request arrives
parameters.help_zh:
指定连接空闲超时时间。单位：秒。

默认值为15，取值范围：1~60。

在超时时间内一直没有访问请求，负载均衡会暂时中断当前连接，直到一下次请求来临时重新建立新的连接
parameters.name: idle_timeout

parameters.help_en:
The request timeout period. Unit: seconds.

Default value: 60. Valid values: 1 to 180.

If no response is received from the backend server within the specified timeout period, Server Load Balancer stops waiting and returns an `HTTP 504` error code to the client
parameters.help_zh:
指定请求超时时间。单位：秒。

默认值为60，取值范围为1~180。

在超时时间内后端服务器一直没有响应，负载均衡将放弃等待，给客户端返回` HTTP 504 `错误码
parameters.name: request_timeout

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the `XForwardedFor_SLBPORT` header to retrieve the listener port of the Server Load Balancer instance. Valid values:
on: yes.
off: no
parameters.help_zh:
是否通过`XForwardedFor_SLBPORT`头字段获取负载均衡实例的监听端口。取值：
on：是。
off：否
parameters.name: xforwarded_for_slbport

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the `XForwardedFor_ClientSrcPort` header to retrieve the port of the client that accesses the Server Load Balancer instance. Valid values:
on: yes.
off: no
parameters.help_zh:
是否通过`XForwardedFor_ClientSrcPort`头字段获取访问负载均衡实例客户端的端口。取值：
on：是。
off：否
parameters.name: xforwarded_for_client_src_port
